text:
elaine_sales: Heads-up: POC with AcmeHealth is hitting intermittent 429s after a test batch. They're doing a 90s burst of health-record prompts. Need swarming — could be per-route cap or token budget. Account: acct_7532. @maya_support @josh_platform

maya_support: On it. Can you paste the exact curl and timestamped error payload? Do we have request IDs?

elaine_sales: They sent this header: `x-request-id: rq_83b2` and response body: `\{"error\":\"rate_limit\",\"message\":\"Quota exceeded\"}`. Logs show `Retry-After: 10` sometimes plus `x-ratelimit-limit: 60` `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0`.

josh_platform: Thanks. Looks like a per-route tokens/sec cap. Which model/route? /v1/generate or /v1/chat?

elaine_sales: /v1/chat with model redwood-large-quantized. Token-heavy prompts (~2.5k tokens each). Burst ~20 reqs in 90s.

ronnie_eng: That model has per-route cap 60rpm by default on POC tenants. 20 reqs * 2500 tokens = 50k tokens in short window. Could hit token budget too. Can you paste raw response with headers?

elaine_sales: ```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"messages":[...]} ' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
x-ratelimit-limit: 60
x-ratelimit-remaining: 0
x-ratelimit-reset: 1769998920
x-request-id: rq_83b2
{"error":{"type":"rate_limit","message":"Per-route token quota exceeded"}}
```

priya_sre: If x-ratelimit-reset is unix ts, that's when bucket replenishes. Two levers: increase per-route cap for this account OR enable burst policy which allows short bursts beyond steady cap for POCs. I can lift burst to 120 for 1 hour if you want.

elaine_sales: Yes please. Customer is doing interactive eval tomorrow. Also need quick answer on cost impact — will burst increase billing or count toward monthly token budget?

josh_platform: Burst counts against the same tokens; billing unchanged. But may hit monthly committed cap for Dedicated seats; for hosted, usage billed per-token. I'll add note to pricing. For POCs we can grant temporary token buffer credits — talk to finance.

maya_support: I'm creating support ticket SUP-2026 with logs + request ids. @ronnie_eng can you add suggested config change (per-route cap -> 120, burst window 5m)?

ronnie_eng: Will do. Proposed change:
- per-route cap for acct_7532: 120 rpm
- burst allowance: up to 2000 tokens/sec for 5m window
- fallback: route to redwood-small for requests >3k tokens

I'll push change to canary and monitor.

elaine_sales: :thumbsup: schedule a 30-min call with the customer at 10am PT. I'll drop in logs and SUP ticket. Thanks team.

priya_sre: Done — burst lifted for 1 hour. Watch metrics in console -> per-account -> acct_7532. I'll monitor for errors. :eyes: 

maya_support: SUP-2026 created: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/SUP-2026 — added traces and recommended config. I'll update customer.

elaine_sales: Amazing. If we still see 429s during the call we'll fallback to smaller model and cut token length.

ratebot: Incident note appended to acct_7532: temporary burst enabled by priya_sre, sup ticket SUP-2026.
